Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "{0}: The next 1 damage that would be dealt to target creature, planeswalker, or player this turn is dealt to this creature instead." Only you may activate this ability.
As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a creature you control or a warped creature card you own in exile.
~ deals damage equal to the power of the chosen creature or card to target creature.
Cast this spell only before attackers are declared.
Black and/or red permanents and spells are colorless sources of damage.

As long as this creature is untapped, noncreature artifacts you control can't be enchanted, they have indestructible, and other players can't gain control of them. This effect doesn't remove Auras already attached to those artifacts.
